title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: Cassie leaves Escanaba at \(8:30\) AM heading for Marquette on her bike. She bikes at a uniform rate of \(12\) miles per hour. Brian leaves Marquette at \(9:00\) AM heading for Escanaba on his bike. He bikes at a uniform rate of \(16\) miles per hour. They both bike on the same \(62\)-mile route between Escanaba and Marquette. At what time in the morning do they meet?

solutions.text:
By the time Brian starts biking, Cassie has already traveled \(\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot 12=6\) miles. This means that Cassie and Brian are then \(62-6=56\) miles apart.

Together, they close the distance at \(12+16=28\) miles per hour. This means that they meet \(56\div 28=2\) hours after \(9{:}00\) AM.

This means that they meet at \(11:00\) AM.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: First account for Cassie’s half-hour head start.
After Brian starts, the distance between them closes at the sum of their speeds.
